examples.name: Binary Search
examples.description: Find a value in a sorted array with an O(log n) loop invariant
examples.learningGoal: See a counted loop maintain a shrinking search range.
examples.expectedOutput: Finds 10 at index 4 and reports that 7 is missing.

examples.name: Merge Sort
examples.description: One O(n log n) sort written as split, recurse, and merge
examples.learningGoal: Read one complete n-log-n sort instead of a catalog of seven.

examples.name: BFS and DFS
examples.description: Walk a list-of-lists graph, then the same walks on the graph builtin
examples.learningGoal: Implement BFS and DFS in user code, then compare graph.bfs / graph.dfs.
examples.expectedOutput: Prints from-scratch and builtin walks that both visit six nodes.

examples.name: 0/1 Knapsack
examples.description: Fill a dynamic-programming table for capacity-limited value
examples.learningGoal: See memoization as a 2D array instead of a recursive tree.

examples.name: Union-Find
examples.description: Disjoint-set union for connected components without a graph object
examples.learningGoal: Link roots so connectivity queries stay cheap.
examples.expectedOutput: Shows 0-2 connected, 0-3 not, then one component after a bridge.

examples.name: Q-Learning Grid
examples.description: Tabular Q-learning on a 4x4 grid, seeded and offline
examples.learningGoal: See a value table learn a policy, not a gradient.
examples.expectedOutput: Prints a greedy policy and a walk that reaches the goal.

examples.name: Simulated Annealing
examples.description: Cool a random 8-city tour until the length is close to the hull
examples.learningGoal: Accept worse moves early, then freeze near a short tour.
examples.expectedOutput: Prints a best length under 9, shorter than the shuffled start.
